name: Master of Data Science
description: This two-year course builds the full working cycle of a data scientist: collecting messy data, cleaning it, modelling it and explaining the result. Students write code every week and finish with a capstone project for a real client.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description: Students learn how learning systems are built, trained and checked, from linear models up to neural networks for language and images. Lab work uses open datasets, and a final research project tests one idea properly. Ethics sits beside the technical units rather than at the end.

name: Master of Bioinformatics
description: A course for people who want to turn sequencing output and biological records into answers. Teaching moves between a short biology refresher and hands-on pipeline work in the command line. Over two years students assemble, annotate and compare genomes.

name: Diploma of Data Analytics
description: A one-year entry course for people new to working with numbers. It covers tidying data, writing basic queries and building clear charts and reports. Classes are practical and use small, realistic datasets.

name: Master of Data Engineering
description: Focused on the plumbing under analytics: how data is moved, stored, checked and made available on time. Students design pipelines, run them on cloud infrastructure and learn to find out why one broke at night. The tone is closer to software engineering than to statistics.

name: Master of Business Analytics
description: In one intensive year, graduates of other fields learn to turn business questions into analysis. Units pair a technique, such as forecasting, with a case discussed in class. The aim is analysts who can explain a model to a manager.

name: Master of Spatial Data Science
description: This one-year course teaches how location changes the way data should be handled. Students work with maps, satellite imagery and sensor points, then model patterns across space. Coursework ends in a mapped analysis of a regional problem.

name: Diploma of Applied Statistics
description: Aimed at people who need sound statistical habits before moving on to larger data studies. Students use free statistical software to design surveys, fit regression models and write up findings in plain language.

name: Master of Data Science
description: Over two years, this course moves from data handling and statistics to large-scale analysis. A supervised placement project lets students apply the methods to an organisation's own records. Reflection on how results are communicated runs through most units.

name: Master of Machine Learning
description: A technical course on how models learn from examples and how to get them into use. Students derive the main algorithms before coding them, then spend time on deployment and monitoring. The second year is mostly project work.

name: Master of Biostatistics
description: Students learn the statistics behind medical and public health studies, including how trials are designed and how patient survival is analysed. R is used throughout. Placement with a health research group is common in the second year.

name: Diploma of Data Engineering Foundations
description: A hands-on first step into building the systems that feed analysts. Students write scripts that move data between sources, load it into databases and check that it arrived intact.

name: Master of Geospatial Data Science
description: This course joins mapping skills with modern machine learning. Students classify satellite images, predict values across a landscape and build spatial databases. Fieldwork days in the first year give the data a place to come from.

name: Diploma of Applied Data Science
description: Two years of steady skill-building for students who want a technical start. The course teaches programming, simple modelling and visual reporting, and includes a workplace project. It works well as a base for later postgraduate study.

name: Master of Computational Biology
description: Students model living systems with equations and code. Early units fill gaps in biology or programming, depending on background, and later ones cover genome analysis and simulation. The research project pairs each student with a laboratory group.

name: Master of Applied Statistics
description: A one-year course for graduates who want deeper statistical modelling. It covers regression, multivariate methods and Bayesian reasoning, with a consulting unit where students answer another person's research question.

name: Diploma of Data Analytics
description: A practical diploma that teaches students to pull data from databases, tidy it and present it in dashboards. Most of the time is spent in the computer lab with a short workplace project at the end.

name: Diploma of Data Engineering
description: Two years of workshop-style classes on how data systems are put together. Students build small pipelines, schedule them and learn to read logs when something fails. A placement block gives time in a working team.

name: Diploma of Machine Learning Applications
description: This diploma shows students how to use existing machine learning tools on real problems without needing advanced mathematics. They train simple models, test them and learn when a model should not be trusted.

name: Diploma of Geospatial Information Systems
description: Students learn to collect, map and analyse location data using desktop GIS software. Field exercises with handheld GPS and drone imagery feed straight into map-making classes. The course suits people moving toward surveying, planning or environmental work.

name: Diploma of Health Data and Statistics
description: A starter course on reading and describing health data. Students work with de-identified records, learn how common measures of illness and risk are calculated and practise reporting them clearly. Privacy rules are taught from the first week.

name: Diploma of Laboratory Data Analysis
description: Built for laboratory technicians who want to handle their instruments' output with code rather than by hand. Students learn simple scripting, check data quality and meet the file formats used in sequencing.

name: Diploma of Business Intelligence
description: Over two years, students learn how an organisation's data is modelled, stored and turned into regular reports. The course alternates between technical workshops and short projects set in a business context.

name: Master of Data Science and Innovation
description: Learning here happens in studios, where small teams take a problem from first question through to a working analysis. Technical units on statistics and machine learning sit alongside methods for framing problems and presenting to non-experts.

name: Master of Advanced Analytics
description: A one-year course for graduates who already have some quantitative background. It concentrates on prediction and on mining text, and it ends with a project built around data supplied by a partner.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description: This course covers both the older and the newer sides of artificial intelligence, from search and logic to neural networks. Students build language and image models in lab classes. A unit on society asks what happens when such systems are used on people.

name: Master of Data Engineering and Cloud
description: Students design and run data platforms in the cloud. Coursework alternates between theory on distributed storage and practical builds where pipelines are deployed, monitored and broken on purpose. Governance units cover access, lineage and retention.

name: Diploma of Data Visualisation
description: A short course on showing data honestly and clearly. Students learn which chart suits which question, build interactive dashboards and critique each other's work in class.

name: Master of Bioinformatics and Genomic Data
description: Students work with real genomic datasets from the first semester. The course teaches programming and statistics alongside biology, so graduates can both build and question an analysis pipeline. A placement in a research or clinical laboratory is offered.

name: Master of Spatial Analytics
description: This one-year course treats the city as a dataset. Students map movement, land use and services, then test models of how they change. The final project is done on a council or planning question.

name: Master of Biostatistics
description: A course for students who want to analyse health studies with care. Topics include trial design, repeated measurements on the same patients and missing data. Software work is in R and SAS-style environments.

name: Master of Data Science
description: Taught over two years with a strong project thread, this course has students work in teams on industry-supplied problems. The technical core covers programming, statistics and large-scale processing. Professional practice units look at working in teams and writing for clients.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description: Students study how machines sense, decide and learn. The course leans toward systems that act in the physical world, so computer vision and robot perception get real room. Many students finish with a thesis built on lab hardware.

name: Master of Business Intelligence and Analytics
description: A one-year option for graduates headed into analyst roles. It teaches how to model business data, report on it and predict the next quarter, with plenty of discussion about what managers actually need to see.

name: Diploma of Data Analytics
description: A gentle introduction to analysis for people without a technical background. Students learn to ask clear questions of data, run simple summaries and build tidy charts. It is a common pathway into a degree.

name: Master of Data Engineering
description: This course trains students to build reliable data systems. Pipelines, storage and orchestration are covered in depth, with weekly labs that run on cloud infrastructure. Testing and monitoring are treated as part of the work, not an extra.

name: Diploma of Machine Learning
description: Two years that begin with programming and school-level mathematics and end with students training their own models. The pace is steady and the assessment is mostly practical.

name: Master of Geographic Data Science
description: This course places spatial thinking at the centre of data science. Students analyse maps, aerial imagery and movement traces and learn why nearby places so often resemble each other. A research project closes each year.

name: Master of Computational Genomics
description: Students learn how to read the output of sequencing machines and find meaning in it. The course joins genetics, statistics and programming, and assessments are usually analyses of public genome datasets. A research placement is offered in the second year.

name: Master of Data Science
description: A two-year course with a lean towards environmental and regional data, though the methods apply anywhere. Students learn programming, modelling and visual reporting, then spend a semester on an applied project with a local partner.

name: Master of Spatial Information Science
description: This course covers the collection, storage and analysis of information tied to place. Students work with satellite images, land surveys and coastal data from nearby study sites. A good deal of the second year is research.

name: Diploma of Applied Data Analysis
description: A one-year diploma that gets students working with data quickly. It starts with spreadsheets, moves to simple databases and statistics, and ends with a short report on a dataset the student chooses.

name: Master of Marine and Environmental Data Science
description: Students analyse the kinds of data collected at sea and in the field, such as tracking tags, water samples and survey grids. The course teaches spatial and time-series methods and expects students to join field data collection at least once.

name: Master of Biostatistics
description: A biostatistics course that stresses careful study design as well as calculation. Students analyse health and ecology datasets, practise writing a statistical analysis plan and complete a supervised project in the second year.

name: Master of Bioinformatics
description: A bridge between the life sciences and computing. Students with a biology background learn code, and those from computing learn the biology, before everyone meets in genome analysis and a research project.

name: Diploma of Data Engineering
description: A starter course in storing and moving data reliably. Students write scripts, set up small databases and run simple pipelines on the cloud. It suits people who are comfortable with a computer but new to engineering.

name: Master of Data Science
description: This course emphasises work-integrated learning, with project units that connect students to organisations needing analysis. The methods covered are the standard toolkit: programming, statistics, machine learning and visual communication.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
description: Students study how machine learning systems are trained and judged, and apply them to text, images and tables. The course keeps coming back to when a model is fair and when it is just fast. A final applied project is done with an outside partner.

name: Diploma of Data Analytics
description: A one-year diploma for learners starting out. Students clean small datasets, write queries and build reports, and they are shown what an analyst does in a typical week. Many go on into a Master's course.

name: Master of Health Biostatistics
description: Taught with a health focus, this course covers the statistical methods used in trials and population studies. Students analyse realistic clinical datasets in R and learn to report results the way journals and regulators expect.

name: Master of Data Engineering
description: Students learn to design and operate the systems that store and move data. Labs cover building pipelines, tuning databases and securing sensitive records. The engineering project is a working platform built to a written specification.

name: Diploma of Spatial Mapping and Analysis
description: A diploma that teaches how to make and interpret maps built from data. Students collect points in the field, edit them in GIS software and answer simple questions such as which areas lack a service.

name: Master of Applied Bioinformatics
description: This course brings computing into biomedical research. Students process sequencing data, query biological databases and check findings statistically. An industry project places them with a research or health data team.

name: Master of Business Analytics
description: Over a single year, students learn to answer business questions with data: who will leave, what will sell, where the delay is. Each technique is taught through a case, and the closing project reports to a real stakeholder.

name: Master of Data Science
description: The course gives equal weight to computing and statistics. Students program in the first semester, study learning methods in the second, and then choose between a research thesis and an industry project. It is demanding in mathematics.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description: A two-year course with substantial mathematics and a research flavour. Students study modern learning methods, including systems that learn by trial and error. Many choose the thesis path and write a paper-length report on an original experiment.

name: Master of Data Engineering
description: Students learn how large data systems are built so that they keep working under load. Topics include distributed storage, scheduling and the checks that catch bad data before it spreads. The project is a pipeline built and defended in front of staff.

name: Master of Bioinformatics
description: Students learn to build tools that read and compare biological sequences, and to judge results statistically. The course draws on both the science and the engineering faculties. The second year is mainly a research project in a hospital or university laboratory.

name: Master of Biostatistics
description: A rigorous course in the methods used to study health and disease. Students move from probability through to models for trials and cohort studies, and they work with researchers on real medical questions during the project year.

name: Master of Spatial Data Science
description: This course adds location-aware methods to a data science toolbox. Students handle maps, imagery and tracking data, and they learn why the usual independence assumptions fail across space. The research project can be on any place-based question.

name: Master of Deep Learning
description: A fast, one-year specialisation for people who already program well. Units cover network architectures, training tricks and generative models, and every unit asks students to train something and report honestly on how well it worked.

name: Diploma of Data Analytics
description: A foundation diploma that prepares students for postgraduate data study. It teaches enough code and statistics to analyse a dataset from start to finish and describe the findings in writing.

name: Master of Data Science
description: A two-year course that builds from programming and statistics to large-scale analysis. Students complete a work-integrated project and keep a portfolio of analyses along the way. Teaching is available in both on-campus and online modes.

name: Master of Artificial Intelligence
description: This course teaches how to build and test systems that learn from data. Practical sessions use shared computing clusters for training larger models. Students also study how mistakes in such systems reach the people affected by them.

name: Diploma of Data Analytics
description: A first-year diploma that covers the basics of preparing, summarising and presenting data. Students learn by working through small, realistic datasets, and assessments are mostly short reports.

name: Master of Data Engineering
description: Students learn how to move and store data at scale in the cloud. The course is built around labs where a pipeline is designed, deployed and then watched as it fails and is repaired. Governance and security are treated as design concerns.

name: Master of Clinical Biostatistics
description: This course covers statistics for medical research: planning a trial, choosing a sample, handling missing patients and reporting an effect honestly. Software work uses R throughout. The project is carried out with a clinical research team.

name: Master of Genomic Data Analysis
description: Students learn to turn raw sequencing reads into findings about genes and disease. The course mixes short lectures with long lab sessions in the command line. A research project in the second year uses data from a partner laboratory.

name: Master of Geospatial Intelligence
description: A one-year course on extracting meaning from imagery and location data. Students process satellite and aerial images, write scripts to automate map work and present their findings as maps and short briefings.

name: Master of Applied Statistics
description: A one-year course for graduates who want to model data with care. It covers regression, multivariate and Bayesian approaches, and ends with a consulting unit where students advise on another person's study.
